description: Mediation Boards Commission - Nominations for the Appointment of Mediators
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the appointment of judicial officers (Chairman and Mediators) to Mediation Boards, which are part of the judicial/alternative dispute resolution system. It involves calling for nominations for these judicial positions across multiple districts, specifying eligibility criteria and appointment procedures under the Mediation Boards Act. This falls squarely within Judicial/Law Enforcement matters (Type 9) as it deals with court-related appointments and the administration of the justice system's mediation framework.
